kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتأقلم (form IIq)
# نَتَأَقْلَمُ (nataʔaqlamu) /na.ta.ʔaq.la.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَأَقْلَمَ (taʔaqlama)
# نَتَأَقْلَمَ (nataʔaqlama) /na.ta.ʔaq.la.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَأَقْلَمَ (taʔaqlama)
# نَتَأَقْلَمْ (nataʔaqlam) /na.ta.ʔaq.lam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَأَقْلَمَ (taʔaqlama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
